crossRefs.note: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them; that you may live, and go in…
You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to…
You shall walk in all the way which Yahweh your God has commanded you, that you may live and that it may be well with…
Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh your God commanded to teach you, that…
You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and…
For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

translations.web: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers.
translations.bsb: You must carefully follow every commandment I am giving you today, so that you may live and multiply, and enter and possess the land that the LORD swore to give your fathers.
translations.kjv: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.
translations.asv: All the commandment which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Jehovah sware unto your fathers.
